critic.fix_suggestion: Replace the single solid grey block on the fuselage side with an array of 12 small rectangular primitives. Each rectangle should have a width-to-height ratio of 3:1, spaced 5mm apart along the horizontal axis of the original block's position to simulate a continuous window line.

discrepancies.observed: A single solid grey block on the fuselage side
discrepancies.reference: A continuous horizontal line of small individual rectangular windows

discrepancies.observed: A single dark geometric shape at the nose
discrepancies.reference: Four distinct panes arranged in a wrap-around cockpit window frame

discrepancies.observed: No visible door geometry or seams on the forward fuselage
discrepancies.reference: A clearly defined vertical rectangular door seam near the nose
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: add a thin vertical plane for the door seam

discrepancies.observed: Smooth continuous fuselage surface over the wing area
discrepancies.reference: Two distinct sets of windows/doors above the wing root
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: add small rectangular cutouts or seams above the wing
